decisions.summary: the smoother cuts a hairpin arm under 40 ft even at the lane's only contact; rejoined at the fold within 25 ft, else committed uncut for the settle
decisions.why: the literal reading of 0081 ('a returning leg under 40 ft is cut'): the only-contact exception the code kept is removed, not narrowed. The fallback keeps no arm on a drawn map, but its stated mechanism is wrong for tree lanes: settle_shapes skips every is_tree lane but the connector, so a tree lane's hairpin is not cut by _unkinked - refuse_unmended refuses the web instead. Correct the plan line and the smooth.py claim ('where no join clears, the settle cuts it') to say so, or cut it for tree lanes too.

decisions.summary: from wave 46 the gate, the timing pair with perf-audit, and the wave's review occasions are taken once per batch of 4-5 waves (batch 1 = waves 42-46, closed by T119); each wave keeps tests, rerolls, notes-census, impl-drift and spec-fidelity
decisions.why: the GM's 2026-10-08 ruling ('batch your lengthy tests'); the review occasions move with the gate because a review is dispatched on a green gate, and they still run at the batch close (T119), so nothing is dropped. The FR-005/FR-006 wording that carries it is a spec amendment and is owed its own spec-fidelity round

decisions.summary: the village lane occasion declared, but its glyph check 'capped at two rounds (listed for the GM's waiver with the others)'
decisions.why: FR-005 requires the occasions a wave opens to be run, and the GM ruled on 2026-10-08 (Decisions Recorded) that this feature's review checks run past two rounds - 'the six units capped at two rounds (... village lane ...) take further rounds instead of a waiver'. The tasks.md Occasions line still routes the village lane check to 'the GM's waiver with the others', contradicting both the ruling and the new T119 ('round 3 allowed by the GM's ruling'). Rewrite it to say the check runs at batch 1's close (T119), round 3 onward under the ruling, covering Kashikawa's road re-squared at the ford (a different rule on a different map) as well as the taut track
